items.prompt: Black to move, castled, against a quiet White set-up. Find a pawn move that strikes at White's centre.

claims.statement: A black pawn stands on e7.
A black pawn stands on c7.
After e5 the pawn attacks d4.
After c5 the pawn attacks d4.
At depth 16 e5 and c5 are within 0.4 pawn of each other and one is the engine's first choice.

hints: Which of your pawns can attack White's d4 pawn?
Two pawns can do it from different files.
Both e5 and c5 attack d4; the engine rates them within 0.4 pawn of each other.
items.explain: Both e5 and c5 put a pawn on a square that attacks d4. At depth 16 they are within 0.4 pawn of each other here. This is the Pirc plan: let White build the centre, then strike it with a pawn.

items.prompt: Black to move. White has pawns on e4, f4 and d4. Which pawn move strikes at the centre without handing White a gain?

hints: Which square does White's f-pawn attack?
One break is covered by the f4 pawn; the other is not.

items.explain: The pawn on f4 attacks e5, so e5 is covered; c5 is not, and it attacks d4. At depth 16 c5 is the engine's first choice and e5 is rated at least one pawn worse.
